rationale: Every lane divergence must be either removed or explicitly registered here with a reason. An unregistered divergence fails `audit.verification.lane_coverage --check`. This is the same wire-or-retire discipline the guard registry uses, applied to lane divergence.

developer_inner_loop_planner.trigger: Re-review when the inner-loop planner changes; it is developer tooling, not a product gate.

frontend_build_tooling.trigger: Re-review when the frontend build gains a deterministic launcher that does not need the Node/pnpm toolchain.

frontend_lane_toolchain.trigger: Re-review when the local lane gains the Node/pnpm toolchain; until then the guard runs remotely only.

push_safety_selftest.trigger: Re-review when the publication lane changes; the helper's self-test follows it.

remote_e2e_preflight.trigger: Re-review when the local lane adopts the e2e preflight; until then it runs remotely only.

remote_unit_shard.trigger: Re-review when the local lane adopts the unit/contract shards; until then they run remotely only.

local_performance_probe.trigger: Re-review when the registered local stack can run inside a remote workflow; until then these probes are local-only by construction.

local_quick_only_unit.trigger: Re-review when a GitHub workflow invokes the same unit targets directly; today the exact-head local quick merge gate is the enforcing lane.
